purpose: Strengthen prospective rider identity beyond name-only matching by verifying that registration-number-keyed KEIRIN.JP profiles expose the rider's current event assignment before the 2026-09-03 locked races begin.
inference_boundary: The verified interface supports contemporaneous prospective identity corroboration for a captured registration-number profile. It does not prove historical participation, lifetime uniqueness semantics, name-change history, or historical values of class/score/style/home-bank/preference fields.
mapping_rule_delta: Exact normalized rider-name mapping still must resolve to one official registration-number profile.
When a current-event assignment is captured, race_date + venue + race_no must exactly match the PRE race card; mismatch is FAIL_CLOSED_EVENT_CONTRADICTION.
For the stronger 2026-09-03 prospective rider-affinity identity gate, profile-only exact name matching without event corroboration does not pass race eligibility.
All current profile attributes other than identity/event corroboration remain excluded from historical or prospective model features unless separately point-in-time prespecified.
